question: Under which of the following governor-General a new policy of "paramountcy" was initiated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Hastings**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Lord Hastings** (1813-1823) was the Governor-General of India during a critical phase of British expansion and consolidation in the Indian subcontinent. 
• He introduced the policy of **"paramountcy"**, which asserted the supreme authority of the British over Indian princely states, overriding traditional treaties and agreements. 
• The policy was aimed at ensuring British dominance and controlling the internal and external affairs of princely states. This was crucial for stabilizing British control over India.
